archetypes.name: White-Blue Fliers
archetypes.plan: Build an evasive force, protect it with efficient interaction, and keep land creatures from stopping attacks with Horizon Drake.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Allies
archetypes.plan: Chain Allies to multiply Halimar Excavator triggers while removal and defensive creatures buy time for the library attack.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Aggro
archetypes.plan: Attack early, use removal to force damage through, and let Ruthless Cullblade become a larger threat once the opponent is wounded.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Landfall
archetypes.plan: Develop Allies and lands together, turn spare lands into attackers with Vastwood Animist, and convert landfall turns into large attacks.

archetypes.name: Green-White Allies
archetypes.plan: Curve Allies into Graypelt Hunter, stack permanent bonuses across the team, and overwhelm blockers with trample and a wide battlefield.
